design_direction.primary_reference: https://www.taylortharptattoo.com/ — clone its cinematic monochrome, centered, large-type aesthetic.
must_keep_brand: Ember accent #C0392B (used for accents, hovers, FAQ numbers).
SHARP corners — border-radius: 0 everywhere, including buttons. Client explicitly: 'nek bude sharp ovaj brend nas.'
design_direction.explicit_intent: 'klon ali zadrzi Ember' — mimic Taylor closely but keep the Ember red and sharp edges.

design_tokens.fonts_loaded: Google Fonts: Inter wght 400;500;700;900 + Space Mono 400;700. Inter covers Serbian diacritics.

critical_css_facts: html,body { overflow-x: clip } — MUST be clip, NOT hidden. overflow-x:hidden breaks position:sticky and killed the circular-gallery pinning. This is a load-bearing fix.
.btn-secondary: transparent-but-blurred bg (rgba(244,238,231,0.03) + backdrop-filter blur(10px)); on hover becomes --ember with an arrow that appears.
.btn-primary hover: letter-scramble/typewriter effect (ported from the 20/44 project code).
Nav: .nav__logo img height 48px, span 24px, .nav__inner height 88px. Logo was deliberately enlarged.
Hero title one line per phrase (user rejected 2-line wrapping): .step__title font-size clamp(28px,4vw,60px) with white-space:nowrap.
O studiju paragraphs: display font, weight 700, clamp(18px,?,28px) — enlarged. Other texts get the reveal effect but were NOT enlarged (user reverted over-enlargement twice).

FAQ: full width (.faq max-width:none), counter-reset:faq; questions use display font weight 900; .acc__trigger grid auto/1fr/auto; ::before shows counter(faq,decimal-leading-zero) in --ember (01, 02...).
Bottom-blur: progressive blur via stacked backdrop-filter layers with MONOTONIC masks (each layer fades in and stays to the bottom). Band masks caused a visible seam line — fixed.

Hero is full-bleed: .hero is full-width, content in .wrap.hero__inner; nav uses .wrap (not wrap-wide) on all 3 pages. This fixed the 'empty space top-right' hero bug where .hero had .wrap so bg didn't reach edges.

hero_circular_badge.css: .hero__badge position:absolute; bottom:44px; right:var(--margin); 152x152; display:none on mobile, grid @>=768px. .circular-text animation circ-spin 22s linear infinite (rotate 0->360), hover speeds to 6s; respects prefers-reduced-motion. Center logo mark 34px.
hero_circular_badge.js: initCircularText() splits data-circular-text into letters, builds a <span> per char, each transformed rotateZ((360/N)*i deg) translate3d(off,off,0). 27 spans generated.
hero_circular_badge.rotation: JS-DRIVEN via requestAnimationFrame (NOT CSS animation). angle += speed*dt each frame; on hover the speed LERPS toward hoverSpeed (speed += (target-speed)*min(1,dt*6)). baseSpeed=360/22 deg/s, hoverSpeed=360/6 deg/s. Hover zone = whole .hero__badge parent. Respects prefers-reduced-motion (no rotation).
hero_circular_badge.why_js_not_css: FIXED 2026-07-11: CSS animation with animation-duration swapped on :hover glitches — the browser recomputes progress against the new duration and the rotation JUMPS instead of continuing. rAF + eased speed removes the jump. Removed @keyframes circ-spin and the :hover duration rule from CSS.
hero_circular_badge.known_limitation: Hero content is ~989px tall so the hero overflows viewport slightly; badge sits at hero bottom-right and is fully visible on 1080p+, a bit below the fold on ~768px laptops. Acceptable, matches Taylor's corner-badge pattern.

javascript_modules.pattern: Single IIFE; init functions run on DOMContentLoaded; $ helper = querySelector.
javascript_modules.WORKS_array: 29 items built via a fixed interleave(). BUG HISTORY: interleave checked arrs[i] instead of arrs[j][i] and produced only 9 items — fixed to `if (arrs[j][i]) out.push(arrs[j][i])`.
key_inits: initHScroll / initCircular — pin-scroll rotating ring gallery. Depends on overflow-x:clip. Verified STICKYTOP=0. CTA moved inside the pinned view to remove big empty space.

initScrollReveal — word-by-word reveal. Selector: '.about__body p, .artist-row__desc, .step__desc, .step__list li, .section-head .lead, .reviews__intro .lead'. Progress p=(vh - r.top)/(vh*0.62 + r.height) — size-aware so short and long texts both finish before leaving screen. baseOpacity 0.1, blur 8. .reveal-word{display:inline-block}.
initBlurReveal — hero title blur-in appear animation (data-blur).
initInkCursor — goo/ink cursor: 20 trailing dots under SVG goo filter (feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 6 + feColorMatrix ... 35 -15 + feComposite atop). #ink-cursor placed right after skip-link.
initButtons — draws frame corners + runs letter-scramble on primary.
initReviewsMarquee — makeMarquee($('.review-row'), 36); moves left, sped up.

key_decisions: Vanilla stack, no build — recreate all pasted React components natively.
Taylor Tharp is the visual north star; keep Ember + sharp corners.
O studiju block is locked — perfect per client, do not edit text or its ScrollReveal.
Only O studiju paragraphs are ENLARGED; all other reveal-affected texts keep normal size (user reverted enlargement twice).
Hero phrase titles must fit on one line (nowrap).
Gallery must PIN on scroll (page stops, images cycle) — not a normal scroll section.
Recent works: horizontal scroll-lock until all seen.
Reveal effects should finish slightly BEFORE text leaves the screen.
constraints_and_gotchas: Environment: Windows 10, PowerShell primary shell + Bash tool available. Working dir has spaces ('Downloads/Claude Code') — quote paths.
Chat paste limit ~50k chars — large site source was downloaded via curl (internet works from Bash) instead of pasting.

Headless Chrome verification: --virtual-time-budget does NOT advance CSS transitions; incognito+virtual-time can yield a wrong ~485px/805px viewport. For screenshots, drop --virtual-time-budget and use a unique --user-data-dir per run; measure via DOM probes (set document.title) rather than trusting timed screenshots.
RECURRING ISSUE: user repeatedly reports features 'don't exist' — nearly always browser CACHE. Always remind: hard-refresh Ctrl+Shift+R.
No em dashes are a client rule on the OTHER (Mojsilov) project, not enforced here, but the user dislikes AI-looking output generally.
context_profile.verification_method: Headless Chrome (C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe) --headless=new --disable-gpu, unique --user-data-dir, --window-size=WxH, --screenshot or --dump-dom. For measurements inject a <script> that writes results into document.title, then grep the <title> from --dump-dom output. Crop screenshots with System.Drawing in PowerShell.
